entries.values: Exactly the text true selects the streaming path of the script. The text false selects the blocking path. The script also passes the text to jq as a JSON value for the 'stream' field of the request (line 346). Text that is not valid JSON, such as TRUE or yes, makes jq fail, and the request counts as failed. Other valid JSON, such as 1, is sent as written, and the script handles the answer as a blocking one.
